items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, John Lee Hooker. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Is he good?

ctx.x: out of listening to him. And he's got all that vim, vop, vip, you know, with him, just like in the olden days. Fantastic. You're not going to believe it. I'm going to get you some tickets and get you -- you got to see it.

So I think it should come out all right, anyway. I mean, -- but I'm not too sure about the Blues Night. But, anyway, it's a good start, you know. They should have some good blues singers, I think. Hooker. You know anybody named Hooker?
